title: Quantification of Nuclear Mitochondrial DNA Insertions (NUMTs) Using Fiber-FI
author: Jeevan Labh
materials: Verify PCR products by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Allow the suspension to dry briefly.
Extend DNA fibers using a coverslip.
Cover with a coverslip and seal edges.
Process image contrast uniformly using Adobe Photoshop CS5.
Count total nuclear DNA fibers analyzed.
Count fibers containing mtDNA integration signals.

steps.title: Isolate Mitochondrial DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate mitochondria from cultured cells through differential centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cultured cells by scraping into 5 ml ice-cold PBS.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 5 ml Solution A (20 mM HEPES-KOH, pH 7.6; 220 mM mannitol; 70 mM sucrose; 1 mM EDTA; 0.5 mM PMSF; 2 mg/ml BSA).
Homogenize cells using a glass homogenizer with 20–30 gentle strokes on ice.
Centrifuge homogenate at 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Centrifuge supernatant at 10,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend the mitochondrial pellet in Solution B (20 mM Hepes-KOH pH 7.6; 220 mM mannitol; 70 mM sucrose; 1 mM EDTA; 0.5 mM PMSF).
Perform a clarifying centrifugation at 800 × g for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant and centrifuge again at 10,000 × g for 10–20 min.
Resuspend the final mitochondrial pellet in sucrose buffer and store on ice until slide preparation.

steps.title: Isolate and Lyse Nuclei
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei from harvested cells and shear the DNA for Fiber-FISH.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend harvested cells in nuclear isolation lysis buffer containing 10% IGEPAL (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.9; 10 mM KCl; 0.1 mM EDTA).
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 3 min.
Repeat the lysis procedure 2–3 additional times to minimize mitochondrial contamination.
Resuspend purified nuclei in PBS.
Lyse the purified nuclei in RIPA Buffer (Tris-HCl 50 mM; Sodium Chloride 150 mM; Triton X-100 1%; Sodium deoxycholate 0.5%; Sodium lauryl sulphate 0.1%).
Perform high powered sonication (3 sets of 10 seconds at 20% amplitude) to break the nuclear envelope and shear DNA.

steps.title: Verify Purity via Western Blot
steps.instruction: Quantify protein and verify the absence of mitochondrial contamination in the nuclear fraction.

substeps.instruction: Quantify total protein concentration using a BCA Assay.
Run a 4-20% Gradient SDS-PAGE and transfer to a 0.2 μm PVDF membrane.
Block with 5% non-fat milk in TBST for 1 hour.
Incubate with Primary Antibody (Rabbit Polyclonal or Mouse Monoclonal Anti-COXII, 1:1000 in 5% BSA) overnight at 4 °C.
Incubate with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody (1:5000 in 5% non-fat milk).
Confirm purity by ensuring a strong band in the mitochondrial lane and no band in the nuclear lane (use twice the protein load in the nuclear lane for accuracy).

steps.title: Prepare Labeled Probes
steps.instruction: Generate labeled DNA probes via PCR and nick translation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare probes using PCR primers (as developed by Singh et al., 2018) and purify products using Centri-Sep spin columns per manufacturer instructions.

Prepare nick translation mixture: 5 μl 0.2 mM dATP/dCTP/dGTP mixture, 1 μl labeled nucleotide (biotin-16-dUTP, digoxigenin-11-dUTP, or DNP-11-dUTP), 1 μg probe DNA, 5 μl DNase I/DNA polymerase mixture, and distilled water to a total volume of 50 μl.
Mix gently, centrifuge briefly, and incubate at 15 °C for 120 min.
Heat inactivate at 65 °C for 10 min, then cool at room temperature for 15 min.
Add 6.25 μl 4 M ammonium acetate and 5 μl 100% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 5 min and carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend labeled probe pellet in 20 μl 100% formamide and store at −20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Mitochondrial DNA Slides
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA fibers from mitochondrial DNA on slides.

substeps.instruction: Apply 5 μl resuspended mitochondrial DNA to the center of a Poly-L-Lysine-coated slide.
Add 15 μl Slide Preparation Lysis Buffer 1 (2% Sarkosyl; 0.25% SDS; 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.4; 50 mM EDTA, pH 8.0; 0.5% Triton X-100).
Incubate slides at 37 °C for 10 min.
Gently place a 22 × 22 mm coverslip over the suspension.
Remove coverslips using a 3:1 ethanol:glacial acetic acid solution.
Dry slides at 60 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclear DNA Slides
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA fibers from nuclear DNA on slides.

substeps.instruction: Deposit 2 μl nuclei suspension on one end of a Poly-L-Lysine slide.
Add 10 μl Slide Preparation Lysis Buffer 2 (0.5% SDS; 5 mM EDTA; 100 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.0).
Incubate at room temperature for 4 min.
Fix slides in 3:1 ethanol:glacial acetic acid for 2 min.
Heat slides at 60 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Perform Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize the labeled probes to the DNA fibers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare hybridization mixture: 50 ng DNA probe, 50% formamide, 10% dextran sulfate, 10 mM EDTA, 3 M NaCl, and 5 μg salmon sperm DNA.
Apply probe mixture to prepared DNA fibers.
Incubate slides overnight at 37 °C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Wash and Detect Probes
steps.instruction: Wash slides and apply specific antibodies based on the probe label.

substeps.instruction: Wash slides twice in 2× SSC for 5 min each at room temperature.
Wash in 50% formamide/2× SSC at 42 °C for 10 min.
Wash in 2× SSC at 42 °C for 10 min.
For Digoxigenin probes: Incubate with mouse anti-digoxigenin antibody (1:200), wash with PBS, then incubate with rabbit anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 568 antibody (1:200).
For Biotin probes: Incubate with goat anti-biotin antibody conjugated with avidin (1:200), wash with PBS, then incubate with streptavidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200).
For DNP probes: Incubate with rabbit anti-DNP antibody, wash with PBS, then incubate with chicken anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 antibody.
Wash slides thoroughly and mount using antifade mounting medium.

steps.title: Image Acquisition and Analysis
steps.instruction: Capture images and quantify NUMT events.

substeps.instruction: Acquire Fiber-FISH images using a Zeiss Axioplan 2 fluorescence microscope with a CoolSNAP HQ2 CCD camera.
Perform signal measurements and fiber length analysis using ImageJ software.
Quantify NUMT events by identifying mtDNA probe signals localized within nuclear DNA fibers.
Calculate NUMT frequency: (Number of fibers containing mtDNA signals / Total nuclear fibers analyzed) × 100.
Measure insertion signal length where applicable.
